{
  "reason": "6 of 8 failure rows have confidence below 0.7 (0.44, 0.60, 0.61, 0.66, 0.67, 0.67) yet were arbitrated; adding (high-confidence? edi-change) gates out these low-trust events. Confident true positives keep recall at/above 0.8 while cutting the 0.714 false-arbitration-rate; existing pct/exposure/frozen thresholds stay unchanged.",
  "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"
}
